items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions 'Chiney' as a drummer; INTERVIEWEE does not respond with personal connection or knowledge of Chiney.

ctx.x: Do you remember who he was playing with or what?
At the time he was playing with, well, I know one of them then. That was a brother like Chiney. Chiney, what he was called Chiney with a drummer with Celeste Ant one time.
